Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Autonomous Systems [CSE_4023]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Explain Semantic segmentation with examples                                                           (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Choose an appropriate segmentation model to classify every pixel of a road scene                      (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Compare Segmentation and Detection                                                                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Explain bathymetry.                                                                                   (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           identify the sensors which help generate bathymetric maps along with vision                           (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           List reasons for combining bathymetry with optical imagery?                                           (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Explain localization                                                                                  (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Identify reasons how sensors help with localization when GPS is unavailable?                          (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           List reasons for the issues with drift in underwater?                                                 (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Explain payload with examples                                                                         (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  Page #1

B)                List the method for mounting cameras so as to minimize vibration?                                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                List the disadvantages of vibrations in computer vision?                                             (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                        Explain Sebsor Fusion                                                                                (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                              Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                List the procedure for LiDAR and camera for 3D perception                                            (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Identify the reasons for fusion being necessary for robust autonomy                                  (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
